t1.text: Hike page v2: the approved 2D layout, drawn to scale from real data

s1.text: Every number here is computed from app/public/data with the app's own models (match.ts, checkpoints.ts, cost.ts, twins.ts), run on Angels Landing: home Seattle, Q4, limit 55 to 85 F, 1 traveller, 2 nights, fly. Only the temperature limit is set, so Q1, Q2 and Q4 all score 100%; Q4 wins the tie because it is $3 cheaper. v1 stays untouched on its own canvas.
